title: pvVoronoiMergeConnected
body:
## pvVoronoiMergeConnected

Merges the cells of a Voronoi tessellation that share the same global RegionId into single polyhedron cells (vtkPMergeConnected), turning per-particle Voronoi cells into one cell per connected region. Input is a multiblock of unstructured grids carrying RegionId on points and cells and a Volumes cell array, as produced by ParaView's cosmology Voronoi tools; output is a multiblock with merged polyhedra, RegionId and summed Volumes. pvMinkowskiFilter can then characterize the shapes.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Inputs without the vtkIdType RegionId arrays and float Volumes array are not handled by the native code; it is not a general mesh-merging filter (use merge or pvMergeBlocks for that).
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `VoronoiMergeConnected`. Identity: `filters/PMergeConnected`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.
